secretsApprovalAllowed: Allowed. This exact run is now a saved decision.
secretsApprovalAlways: On your computer, saves this exact run: the same program, files, arguments and folder. Anything different asks again.
secretsApprovalAlwaysOn: Saves this exact run on {computer} only: the same program, files, arguments and folder. Anything different, or another computer, asks again.
secretsApprovalAskedApp: Asked by Infinitary itself, not by a task.
secretsApprovalAskedTask: Asked by the crewmate on this task, in its own words.
secretsApprovalConfirm: Each allow asks you to confirm first.
secretsApprovalConfirmAlways: Allow the exact Secrets use shown in Infinitary now and every time it is asked again.
secretsApprovalConfirmOnce: Allow the exact Secrets use shown in Infinitary once.

secretsApprovalConfirmRead.one: Allow this exact read for {minutes} minutes or {uses} use, whichever ends first.
secretsApprovalConfirmRead.other: Allow this exact read for {minutes} minutes or {uses} uses, whichever ends first.

secretsApprovalKeepMany: What receives them can keep them.
secretsApprovalKeepOne: What receives it can keep it.
secretsApprovalNever: Allowing never approves a separate action, such as deploying or sending something.
secretsApprovalNotKept: This run was allowed, but the saved decision was not kept because your decisions changed while it ran. Nothing else changed.
secretsApprovalOnceMany: Only these secrets, only this run.
secretsApprovalOnceOne: Only this secret, only this run.

secretsApprovalRead.one: On your computer, repeats only this exact read, up to {uses} time. You can stop it in Settings → Secrets.
secretsApprovalRead.other: On your computer, repeats only this exact read, up to {uses} times. You can stop it in Settings → Secrets.

secretsArchiveSaveMessage: Choose a new file. Existing archives will not be replaced.
secretsAskAskedFirstMate: Asked by the first mate, in its own words.
secretsAskAskedTask: Asked by the crewmate on “{task}”, in its own words.
secretsAskByCrewmate: Written by the crewmate. Check each address before you sign in.
secretsAskByFirstMate: Written by the first mate. Check each address before you sign in.
secretsAskClosed: The task that asked has closed, so nothing was saved.
secretsAskElsewhere: No field shows here? Answer this card in Infinitary on the first mate's computer, or update Infinitary on this one.
secretsAskEmpty: Type a value in every field before saving.
secretsAskEnded: This request for a secret ended.
secretsAskGone: This card no longer asks. Nothing was saved.
secretsAskLocked: Secrets storage is locked. Unlock it, then save again.
secretsAskNoteMany: Each goes straight into Secrets and is never shown again. Your first mate and crew get their names, never the values, and each use still asks you.
secretsAskNoteOne: It goes straight into Secrets and is never shown again. Your first mate and crew get its name, never the value, and each use still asks you.
secretsAskRecovery: Secrets storage needs recovery before it can save anything. Open Settings → Secrets to see the options.
secretsAskStale: This secret changed since the card asked. The card now names its current version.
secretsAskUnavailable: Secrets could not save this now. Nothing was saved; try Save again.
secretsBringCannotEmpty: Empty in the source, so it cannot be kept.
secretsBringCannotNotText: Not text, so it cannot be kept.
secretsBringCannotTooLarge: Larger than 1 MB, so it cannot be kept.
secretsBringNote: Infinitary runs the command or reads the file itself and keeps only what you tick. No value is shown here.
secretsBringReplaces: Already in Secrets, version {version}. Tick to replace it.
secretsKeySaveMessage: Keep this key separately from the archive. Anyone with both can read the saved secrets. There is no key reset.
